about: Every fork edit to a file that also exists upstream needs a row here.
One physical path per row. Globs are rejected by the checker.
status 'planned' means the row is forward-declared from the implementation
plan and the path has not been touched yet; flip it to 'modified' in the same
commit that first changes the file, and say what invariant the edit implements.
Genuinely new fork-owned paths are not listed row by row; they must fall under
a declared prefix in fork_owned_areas, which the checker reports separately.

owners.channel: Channel identity, feature policy, paths and exhaustive match sites.
owners.services-boundary: Compile boundary between local product and upstream hosted services.
owners.identity: Branding, marks, URI scheme, menus and installer identity.
owners.materials: Renderer chrome policy, bevels, theme and material coverage.
owners.plate: Status plate geometry, data adapter and workspace integration.
owners.packaging: Platform bundle scripts and artifact manifests.
owners.ci: Fork CI workflows and verification scripts.

Fork binary wrapper that sets the channel before entering the app.
Fork channel assets, icons, desktop metadata and version source.
Fork product policy, startup, branding, theme, chrome and plate integration.
Fork GUI integration cases built with the Doom Term policy.
Pure plate geometry, glyph data, presentation state and pixel operations.
Read-only local session discovery, association, capture and activity.
Public-only CI environment setup with no upstream credentials.
Fork CI and release workflows, kept separate from the upstream ones.
